subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should unset QMD configs broadly inherit a 600s embed timeout and longer derived lock waits, or should this fix be narrowed until real QMD/GGUF proof is supplied?
rationale: The patch is small, but it changes upgrade behavior for every existing QMD user without an explicit timeout, so automation cannot choose the product/default tradeoff safely.

options.title: Require proof or override
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted real QMD/GGUF runtime proof is supplied or a maintainer explicitly accepts the default-risk tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the broad default
options.body: Merge the 600s default knowing existing unset QMD users may wait and consume CPU longer before failures surface.

options.title: Narrow the timeout strategy
options.body: Pause this branch and pursue a selective local-GGUF default, opt-in setting, or warning/docs-only path instead.
